title: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
question: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN T1.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.molecule_id)
FROM molecule_bond AS T1
WHERE T1.bond_type = '#'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "molecule_bond"."label" = '+' THEN "atom"."molecule_id" END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT "atom"."molecule_id")
FROM "atom"
JOIN "molecule_bond" ON "atom"."molecule_id" = "molecule_bond"."label"
WHERE "molecule_bond"."bond_type" = '#';
